svg.title: FTA SG-02 sheet 2 of 6: loss or degradation of lateral control without adequate take-over warning
svg.text: Loss or degradation of lateral control without adequate take-over warning
EPS drops LKA assistance and no
EPS fault seen only by the host,
refuses LKA torque on a fault
HMI does not deliver the warning
HMI hang: render loop or audio
that is not a driver action
whose ACC cancel had no effect …
One basic event in the item reaches the top event; undeveloped events outside the item assumed.
Computed from the gate logic (see cut-sets.md); the SPF tags are WP-A-04's own claims.
